reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

Thank you for reaching out. I've checked our records and can confirm that transfer TRF-INV-88 (₦250,000 to your Access Bank account, 0234567891) shows as "failed" on our side as well, so no money left our account for that attempt.

Before we resend, I'd like to make sure the receiving account is set up correctly, since the previous attempt to these exact details failed. Could you please:

1. Confirm the exact account name registered on Access Bank account 0234567891, so we can make sure it matches the recipient (Chidi's Farm Produce / your name as the bank has it), and
2. Check with Access Bank whether there is any restriction or issue on the account that could block incoming transfers.

As soon as you confirm these details — or send us any corrected ones — we'll resend the ₦250,000 right away and share the new transfer reference with you.

Apologies for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
Mama's Kitchen Operations

[after the person answered]

Good afternoon Chidi,

I understand this is frustrating, and I'm sorry for the delay. However, I'm not able to simply resend to the same details just yet. Our policy is not to retry a failed transfer until the receiving account's setup has been confirmed or corrected — resending to the same unverified details would most likely fail again, and that would delay you even further.

To get this moving today, please could you do one of the following:

1. Confirm the exact account name that Access Bank has registered for account 0234567891 (as it appears on a bank statement or account slip), or
2. Send alternative/corrected account details if there's any doubt about the current ones.

Once I have that confirmation — or corrected details — I will resend the ₦250,000 immediately and share the new transfer reference with you.

If you're unable to confirm the account details from your side, let me know and I'll hand this to a member of our team who can look into it further with the bank.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
Mama's Kitchen Operations
